newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia increases Latam cargo capacity.
newsitem.headline: Iberia increases Latam cargo capacity.

text.p: Iberia is planning to schedule a second weekly 747 freighter from Barcelona and Madrid to Buenos Aires, possibly starting this Thursday, a cargo official said.

This, like the 747 freighter already flying Maastricht-Madrid-Buenos Aires on Sundays, will be a joint flight with Aerolineas Argentinas and will probably be coded as an Aerolineas flight. The plan initially is to run the new service for four weeks.
Airlines report very strong demand on routes from Europe in general to Latin America this month as the peak cargo season gets underway and cargo space on many flights from Madrid is full, they say.

Iberia has begun using Airbus Industrie A340s for its daily Madrid-Mexico passenger service instead of the 747-200s it flies over the summer season when passenger numbers are higher, another official said. This gives it a daily cargo capacity of 15 to 16 tonnes on the route, more than it usually achieved with the 747s. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
